notes: The supplied *the* in *all the righteous blood* goes to the anarthrous noun αἷμα under rule 58, not to the quantifier or the adjective beside it.
υἱοῦ is expressed, so no supplied relational noun is in question and rule 52 does not apply; ἕως and μεταξύ are each rendered by a single word, so no rule 71 frame arises.
